verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Node.js compatibility in the Workers runtime itself, and a community report says the lack of a full Node runtime blocks typical apps from moving off Vercel/Netlify. The only route to unmodified Node code is the separate Containers product, which runs code 'built for any runtime' as part of Workers apps. Sandbox SDK containers also provide a full Linux environment, but these are extra products rather than the edge functions themselves. Missing for 10: documented Node.js API compatibility in Workers, evidence that npm packages run unmodified in Workers, independent hands-on confirmation, and evidence that the container route meets edge/serverless function expectations.
